name: forkpair_hwm
description: Concurrent fork (apple/fgx#494): ps's heap high-water mark for a parked member is its own.  The child sleeps (parked); the parent raises its break by 8 KB and reads both marks through procs(2): they must differ.  On a deferred-parent fork the parent runs only after the child has exited, so the child has no record and FP HWM FAIL.
